agentSetup.compressionRatioThresholdDesc: Saved share after context compaction. 90% = compress until 10% remains. Range 50%–95%, default 90%.
agentSetup.intentIdleRotateHoursDesc: A new Intent arriving after this much idle starts a fresh execution session (1–72; 0 disables). Default 24.
agentSetup.intentHandoffMaxTokensDesc: Target size of the distilled summary carried into a rotated session after long-running-task compaction (500–4000). Default 1500.
agentSetup.resetTemperature: Clear temperature override, revert to package default
agentSetup.contextWindowDesc: Max context tokens per request. 0 or empty = no limit (use model's full window). Set a value to cap token usage for this agent.
